description: Gear up for action and adventure with our Tactical Traveler Sling Bag. Built with a portable & lightweight design, the tactical sling backpack keeps your EDC essentials and CCW gear close to you. The main compartment features a quick access two-way zipper and inner loop panel for discretely concealing a firearm, ensuring you are ready at a moment’s notice. From tactical enthusiasts and shooting sport pros to frequent travelers, this tactical crossbody bag offers unbeatable on-the-go storage and utility. Rugged Material Construction: Engineered with tough, water-resistant PVC backed polyester, these tactical backpacks easily endure field missions and outdoor expeditions. Whether you are out traveling or heading to the range, these crossbody sling bags provide long-lasting durability. Safe & Secure Storage: The tactical travel bag utilizes a main compartment with rear zipper pocket, a secondary compartment with 3 utility pockets, and 2 exterior zipper pockets for carrying travel essentials, along with a loop panel for securing gear. The concealed carry sling backpack has a storage capacity of 10 Liters. Customizable Carry Options: This versatile utility sling bag uses an adjustable shoulder strap that extends up to 56 inches, allowing you to wear it across your body as a crossbody bag or behind your back as a daypack. The shoulder strap features a quick-release buckle for an easy on/off. The top grab handle provides easy handling. Travel Ready: As part of Rothco’s Tactical Traveler series, the sling bag features a low-profile MOLLE compatible design and padded air mesh on the back for a comfortable carry while traveling. Our Tactical Traveler bags offer rugged utility that blends seamlessly with everyday travel.
